children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may retest resistance at $7.43 per bushel, a break above which may lead to a gain into $7.47-3/4 to $7.53-1/2 range.
The market stabilized around a support at $7.23 and started a decent bounce. The support is identified as the 61.8% projection level of a wave c from $7.62-1/2.
This wave may either end around the support or extend to $6.98-1/2. Given that the contract has climbed above a falling trendline, the wave c might have ended.
A retracement analysis on the fall from $7.63 to $7.23-1/4 reveals a target at $7.47-3/4, as long as the contract hovers above the support at $7.32-1/2.
On the daily chart, a bullish piercing pattern formed between Sept. 9 and Sept. 10, suggesting a further bounce toward $7.51-3/4.
